notes: One row per provider (provider_approval_number). entity_form is a conservative classification of Legal Name by suffix and keyword; it is a heuristic, not a legal determination. Names are withheld fail closed (CLAUDE.md rule 2): legal_name and trading_name are null and name_withheld is true unless the legal name is positively an organisation (company, incorporated association, cooperative, government, church, an organisation trustee of a trust not named after a person, or an unknown-form name with an organisation word). Addresses are not carried over. service_count joins on provider_approval_number in the services table; providers with no services in that table have service_count 0, which is not evidence that they operate none.
